verdict.rationale: The product is itself a built-in AI assistant to which you delegate work. The docs describe describing a job in a message, Bots working on a persistent cloud computer while your laptop is closed, multi-step skills rerun on schedules, and handoffs between Bots. A month-long hands-on user independently corroborates that async delegation 'actually works' and gives a real example: one Bot contacting about 40 suppliers, negotiating prices and getting samples made.
